mapper.select: SELECT r.response_id AS responseId, r.wanted_id AS wantedId, r.user_id AS userId, r.message AS message, r.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS username FROM wanted_response r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.wanted_id = #{wantedId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.response_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wanted_response (wanted_id, user_id, message) VALUES (#{wantedId}, #{userId}, #{message}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE message = VALUES(message)
